page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The lack of integrated local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance specifically for workloads that rely heavily on raw CPU execution rather than high-speed local disk I/O or parallelized graphics processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.13xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute cores relative to its memory footprint. This makes it a resource-efficient option for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory allocations. Suitable workloads include compute-heavy web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and CPU-based compilation or simulation tasks.
